title: Cross-cohort transportability and context boundaries of published myeloid states in CRC and CRLM
retained_invariants: Human CRC-CRLM immune ecology; patient-level inference; single-cell plus spatial evidence
primary_change_axis: Single named SPP1 mechanism to a preregistered panel of published myeloid states and their cross-cohort transportability
learning_value: Metadata lineage; state mapping; replicate-aware inference; meta-analysis; spatial validation
target_contribution: A reproducibility and evidence-strength map that separates generalizable tissue-associated programs from cohort-specific labels
novelty_floor: Must resolve a real contradiction or boundary across independent cohorts; another SPP1 enrichment plot is insufficient
data_feasibility: Medium-high: GSE164522, GSE225857, Bellomo, NMP and the CRC atlas are public, subject to overlap and metadata audit
code_basis: Strong engineering donor from crc-atlas plus official maintained statistical packages; article scripts used only as traceable fragments
statistical_identifiability: Medium-high if effects are estimated within cohort at patient/sample level and then meta-analyzed
main_fatal_veto: Fewer than three independent usable cohorts, fewer than two cohorts sharing the main contrast, no orthogonal spatial cohort, or state definitions cannot be frozen before validation
claim_ceiling: Associational transportability, heterogeneity and spatial localization; no causality, therapy synergy or clinical biomarker claim

title: External validation of malignancy-linked versus liver-niche-linked immune programs in CRC metastasis
retained_invariants: Human paired tissue ecology; patient unit; discovery-validation separation
primary_change_axis: Single target state to an ecological question separating malignancy-associated from organ-niche-associated programs
learning_value: Reference mapping across lineages; domain shift; matched-tissue design; external validation
target_contribution: An externally validated map of which immune programs follow tumor identity versus liver context
novelty_floor: Beyond reproducing the original M-type/N-type labels, at least one externally validated boundary or failure mode must be demonstrated
data_feasibility: Medium: discovery data are strong, but truly independent matched primary, metastasis and adjacent-liver cohorts are limited
code_basis: CRC atlas precomputed reference plus official mapping and patient-level inference code; paper code cannot be the sole base
statistical_identifiability: Medium-low because tissue, study, processing and treatment may be inseparable in external cohorts
main_fatal_veto: Fewer than two non-overlapping external matched cohorts or inability to separate tissue from study/treatment effects
claim_ceiling: Associational ecological alignment or classification; no lineage origin, differentiation direction or causal niche claim

title: Macrophage-program remodeling during neoadjuvant PD-1 therapy in dMMR CRC
retained_invariants: Patient-level immune ecology and a bounded macrophage focus
primary_change_axis: Metastatic-context comparison to treatment-context paired remodeling
learning_value: Paired design; response-label audit; treatment interaction; exploratory validation
target_contribution: A modest treatment-context paper if an independent validation source becomes available
novelty_floor: Must add an independently validated treatment-response boundary rather than re-describe GSE205506
data_feasibility: Low-medium: GSE205506 is public but has 19 patients, mixed anti-PD-1 and celecoxib arms, incomplete pairing and no clear independent CRC ICI single-cell validation
code_basis: Public processed data and official methods; no strong paper-specific workflow found
statistical_identifiability: Low for response prediction; medium for descriptive paired remodeling
main_fatal_veto: No non-overlapping validation cohort, insufficient paired biological units, or treatment arm remains inseparable from response
claim_ceiling: Exploratory treatment association only; no predictive biomarker, efficacy or causal claim

title: Approximate reconstruction of the anchor computational figures
retained_invariants: Anchor question, tissues and figure logic
target_contribution: A transparent learning reproduction and reusable adapters, not a new manuscript
novelty_floor: Not applicable as a manuscript direction
data_feasibility: Medium for approximate Figures 1-8; blocked for exact values, velocity, private imaging and animal work
code_basis: Rebuilt tested workflow plus traceable fragments; no author workflow exists
statistical_identifiability: Low for exact replication; adequate for descriptive reconstruction
main_fatal_veto: Mistaking independent reconstruction for exact reproduction or treating it as a novel paper
claim_ceiling: Descriptive similarity and documented discrepancies only

title: Another SPP1+TAM mechanism paper in CRLM
retained_invariants: Cancer, cell state and metastatic site unchanged
primary_change_axis: Replace only a receptor, partner, pathway or drug
novelty_floor: Would require genuinely new specific perturbation and human validation, which are not available
code_basis: No suitable complete public experimental workflow
main_fatal_veto: Nearest-neighbor saturation plus absence of specific intervention data

title: Replace TAMs with neutrophils in CRC/CRLM
novelty_floor: Must exceed the 2026 4.27-million-cell multi-modal CRC neutrophil atlas
data_feasibility: High data access but extremely large
code_basis: Excellent Nextflow and containerized donor, but exact build used A100 80 GB hardware
main_fatal_veto: Focal scientific space is already comprehensively occupied; simple substitution fails novelty
claim_ceiling: Associational at best without new experiments

title: CAF-SPP1 macrophage spatial niche in CRLM
novelty_floor: Would need a new spatially testable interaction beyond existing FAP/mCAF-SPP1 studies
statistical_identifiability: Low-to-medium because co-localization and inferred communication are not mechanism
main_fatal_veto: Qi 2022 and Chang 2026 already occupy the central narrative

title: ATP5F1E versus MT-CO1 TAM metabolic subtype as the main axis
learning_value: Low if treated as a biological subtype
novelty_floor: Must first prove the partition is not mitochondrial QC, stress or sequencing-depth artifact
data_feasibility: Low because exact object, velocity layers and validation are missing
main_fatal_veto: Subtype disappears under QC, sample-aware testing or independent mapping; current inputs cannot resolve the artifact risk

title: Generic pan-cancer SPP1 macrophage analysis
novelty_floor: Must exceed existing CXCL9:SPP1 and pan-cancer myeloid atlases with a predeclared new question
data_feasibility: High public-data availability but high harmonization burden
statistical_identifiability: Low-to-medium due cancer, study and platform confounding
main_fatal_veto: Scope expansion without a new estimand produces a larger but not more novel analysis

title: Multi-organ metastatic immune ecology using the progressive-plasticity cohort
retained_invariants: Matched CRC primary and multiple metastatic organs
novelty_floor: Must have immune cells and matched metadata across multiple organs with external validation
data_feasibility: Uncertain: CELLxGENE release is epithelial-only and the public 28.4 GB All.h5ad has undocumented cell scope
statistical_identifiability: Unknown until immune content and sample coverage are verified
main_fatal_veto: Public object may not contain the required immune cells or enough donors per metastatic organ
